what: Each character of a stat number gets its own cell, and once on screen it flips through random characters (0~9 · symbols) one cell at a time — the first 60% at a fast 40ms per cell, then slowing toward the end up to 320ms (a cell flip uses steps(10) over .85 of that length), and when the remaining time drops below one and a half cells it lands on its real character. Each position starts min(50ms, 5% of length) later so the right-hand digits stop in turn. Default duration 2s

options.glyphs: Set of characters to cycle through, default 0123456789#%&@$*+?
options.on: view (default, once when it enters the screen) · manual (only when fx:roll is sent)
options.fx:roll: Send to the element to roll it again

from.where: index.html·about.html stat card numbers (original o-stat-card slot: 40→320ms · .6 threshold · steps(10) · .85 · position delay min(50, length×.05))
